services.value: Water Laboratories, Inc. provides real estate-related water testing for private wells, including tests such as Coliform Bacteria, E-Coli, Nitrate, Nitrite, Lead, and Arsenic. It also offers drinking water analysis using equipment including Perkin-Elmer Atomic Absorption Spectrometer, Latchet Ion Analyzer, Hach Spectrometer, and a Denna sample digester.
